YOLOv26 Powered

High-speed dog detection at scale

A complete pipeline for preparing datasets, training, batch inference, and integrating predictions into Label Studio.

Try the Demo Get Started

Features

📦

Dataset Preparation

Convert Label Studio exports to YOLO format with class filtering, background sampling, and optional compression.

⚡

High-Speed Inference

Process millions of images using GPU acceleration with batched inference and instant random sampling.

🔌

Label Studio Integration

FastAPI prediction server and automated task generation for active learning workflows.

🗃️

Database Logging

SQLite tracking of predictions and errors for auditing, analysis, and reprocessing.

🖼️

Image Optimization

Compress and resize images during dataset preparation to reduce storage and speed up training.

🎯

Hard Negative Mining

Include hallucinated and false-positive images in training to improve model robustness.

Quick Start

1

Clone & install

git clone https://github.com/Alyetama/dog_detection.git
cd dog_detection
pip install -r requirements.txt
2

Configure environment

For Label Studio integration and S3 support, copy the example environment file and fill in your credentials.

cp .env.example .env
3

Run the pipeline

Prepare your dataset, train a model, then run inference or start the prediction API.

View scripts

Scripts

01

Export Annotations

Shell helper to export a Label Studio project.

bash export_annotations.sh
02

Prepare Dataset

Convert a Label Studio JSON export into YOLO training data with train/val splits locked by split_tracker.json.

python prepare_detection_yolo_dataset.py \
  -f annotations.json \
  -l annotations_group \
  --background \
  --compress
Full arguments
ArgumentRequiredDescription
-f, --project-exported-fileYesLabel Studio JSON export
-l, --label-byYesParent group name containing labels
-i, --images-dirNoLocal directory to copy images from
-e, --exclude-classesNoComma-separated classes to exclude
--single-classNoTreat all classes as single target (id 0)
--backgroundNoInclude background images (~10% of dataset)
--hallucinationsNoDirectory with hard negative images
--hallucination-ratioNoFraction of background budget for hard negatives (default 0.5)
--compressNoEnable image compression
--compress-sizeNoMax dimension (default 1280)
--compress-qualityNoJPEG quality 1-100 (default 95)
--tracker-fileNoJSON file locking images to train/val splits
--extract-classNoClasses to copy into a separate folder
--extract-dirNoDestination folder for extracted images
03

Run Inference

Batch inference over large image collections with optional database logging, visualization, and random sampling.

python predict_and_filter.py \
  -w best.pt \
  -s /path/to/images \
  -o output_dir \
  --batch 8 \
  --db predictions.db
Full arguments
ArgumentDefaultDescription
-w, --weights—Path to YOLO weights (required)
-s, --source—Base directory to scan (required)
-o, --output—Output directory (required)
-p, --pattern—Glob pattern for subdirectories
-c, --conf0.25Confidence threshold
--imgsz1280Inference image size
--batch8Batch size
--half—Enable FP16 inference
--db—SQLite database path
--copy—Copy detected images to output
--visualize—Save annotated images
--select-random N—Sample N random images instantly
--reindex—Force rebuild of image index
04

Prediction API

FastAPI server for Label Studio. The model loads lazily and unloads from GPU VRAM after 5 minutes of inactivity.

python prediction_api.py \
  -w best.pt \
  -m "model_v1.0" \
  -H 0.0.0.0 \
  -s 8000
Arguments
ArgumentDefaultDescription
-w, --weights—Path/URL to weights (required)
-m, --model-version—Model name/version
-d, --image-dir—Local image directory
-H, --host0.0.0.0API host
-s, --port8000API port

Endpoint: POST /predict with JSON body {"task": {...}, "project": 123}

05

Send Predictions to Label Studio

Generate predictions for all unlabeled tasks and send them to the prediction API automatically.

python send_prediction_tasks.py \
  --ls-url http://localhost:8080 \
  --project-id 12 \
  --ml-api-url http://localhost:8000/predict

Set LABEL_STUDIO_TOKEN in .env so the script can authenticate.

06

Collect "Other Animal" Images

Extract all images annotated with a specific class for use as hallucination training data.

python generate_other_animals.py \
  -f annotations.json \
  -l annotations_group \
  -o other_animals \
  -c "other animal"

Database Schema

predictions

CREATE TABLE predictions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  region_name TEXT,
  parent_region_name TEXT,
  image_full_path TEXT UNIQUE,
  image_id TEXT,
  num_detections INTEGER,
  conf_per_detection TEXT
);

errors

CREATE TABLE errors (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  image_full_path TEXT UNIQUE,
  image_id TEXT,
  region_name TEXT,
  parent_region_name TEXT,
  error_message TEXT
);
